reviews.text: Two girls who pay attention to everything…
Reliable and efficient dog training center. The trainer, Patrizia, is truly helpful and attentive, very professional, and an exceptional person. My Nanuk adores her.

It's relatively easy to assume that those who choose this profession love dogs and know how to empathize with them; but knowing how to work with people, connecting with human families, making them feel supported, cared for, and understood throughout their dog's journey is a whole other level of professionalism, and unfortunately not so common.
At "Attenti" al Cane, we found all this and much more: priority given to knowing our dog, his motivations, emotions, fears, desires, but at the same time, a great deal of attention to the human client—because those who work in the helping professions (and dog trainers are among them) need more than just be competent in their field; they must know how to make people feel welcome, as the journey can only be successful if it takes place in a safe space where trust and respect are established.
A heartfelt thank you to everyone involved in this center—Patrizia, Giuseppina, Veronica, their furry and non-furry families, and all the more or less knowledgeable extras :D
